name: Ikit Claw
canonNotes: Chief Warlock Engineer of Clan Skryre, with an iron mask and exoskeleton after a failed experiment, master of warp-science.
Builds terrible weapons and dreams of the Doom-Rocket.
voiceNotes: Maniacal, brilliant and impatient; speaks of experiments and warp-power.
Disdains the other clans; treacherous as all Skaven.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
